title: great for tiny/mini food
text: great for tiny/mini food. I bought these out of convenience to use at a family meal I was putting on... they are really small... 4" from tip to tip... but they worked.  I used with mini bundt cakes I made.  Would be useful with appetizers too, tasting plates.  They are plastic, obviously and fairly sturdy. They do have a little flair/style at the prong.  I like them.  I will update if there are any use issues.

product_metadata.title: WNA Reflections Fancy Plastic Fork, Set of 48
